sheets.title: Deccan and South 750 – 1350: Rashtrakutas, Cholas, Chalukyas, Hoysalas, Yadavas
sheets.intro: Rashtrakuta, Chola, Kalyani and Vengi Chalukya, Kakatiya, Hoysala, Yadava kings.

rows.v: c. 753 – 973; capital Manyakheta (Malkhed) from Amoghavarsha I
735 – 756; overthrew Chalukya Kirtivarman II; inscription in Dashavatara cave (15), Ellora; daughter married Pallava Nandivarman II
Kailasa temple, Ellora cave 16 – carved top-down from one rock
780 – 793; first to go north – beat Vatsaraja, Dharmapala
Greatest soldier; Kanyakumari to Kannauj; beat Nagabhata II
814 – 878; about 64 years; Kavirajamarga (Kannada poetics); Prashnottara Ratnamalika; Jain (guru Jinasena); Suleman – one of 4 great kings of the world
914 – 929; sacked Kannauj 916 (Pratihara Mahipala); al-Masudi came
939 – 967; Takkolam 949 – beat Chola Parantaka I; took Kanchi, Tanjore
Last; overthrown by Tailapa II (973)

keys.name: Rashtrakuta culture and rule

rows.v: 34 caves – 1 – 12 Buddhist, 13 – 29 Hindu, 30 – 34 Jain; UNESCO 1983
Ravana shaking Kailasa; Durga slaying Mahisha; elephants carry the plinth; Dravida style
Trimurti (Mahesamurti) – Rashtrakuta (some say Kalachuri)
Pampa (Adikavi) – Adipurana, Vikramarjuna Vijaya; Ponna – Shantipurana; Ranna – Gadayuddha (Kalyani court); "three gems"
Jinasena – Adipurana, Parshvabhyudaya; Mahaviracharya – Ganitasarasangraha; Sakatayana – Amoghavritti
Rashtra (rashtrapati) → Vishaya (vishayapati) → Bhukti → village
King called "Balhara" (Vallabharaja); Bharuch port

traps: Ellora has 3 faiths; Ajanta only Buddhist

Manasollasa (encyclopaedia); "Sarvajna Chakravarti"
Feudatories rose – Hoysalas, Yadavas, Kakatiyas; Kalachuri Bijjala (minister Basavanna)
Kubja Vishnuvardhana, 624 (brother of Pulakeshin II)
Vengi (Pedavegi, near Eluru), later Rajamahendravaram
1019 – 1061; Nannaya began the Andhra Mahabharatam; married Ammangadevi (Rajendra Chola's daughter)
Son Kulottunga I became Chola emperor (1070)
c. 850; took Thanjavur from the Muttaraiyars; Durga (Nisumbhasudini) temple
871 – 907; beat Pallava Aparajita
907 – 955; Maduraikonda; Uttaramerur inscriptions 919, 921; lost Takkolam 949
985 – 1014; born Arumolivarman
Mummudi Chola, Shivapadasekhara
Kandalur Salai – Chera fleet destroyed; Maldives annexed

Brihadisvara (Rajarajeswara), Thanjavur – "Dakshina Meru"; 59.8 m vimana; consecrated 1010; gate Rajarajantiruvasal; murals
Helped the Sailendra king build Chudamani Vihara, Nagapattinam
1022 – beat Pala Mahipala; no land kept; title Gangaikondachola; new capital Gangaikondacholapuram (temple done 1035, 53 m)
Raided Srivijaya – Kadaram (Kedah) – "Kadaramkonda"; envoys to China
Chola-Pandya viceroy at Madurai

keys.name: Later Cholas

rows.v: 1044 – 1054; killed at Koppam vs Someshvara I
1063 – 1070; beat Chalukyas at Kudal Sangamam; patron of Buddhamitra
1070 – 1122; joined Vengi; abolished tolls ("Sungam tavirtta"); land re-survey; 72 merchants to China (1077); lost Ceylon to Vijayabahu I
1146 – 1173; Airavatesvara, Darasuram – chariot mandapa
1246 – 1279; last; Pandyas took over

traps: Takkolam 949 (Rashtrakuta beat Chola) ≠ Koppam 1054 (Chola king killed)
